title: Without & Disregarding: なくして, ことなしに, をよそに, をものともせず, を顧みず, をいいことに
description: Without (it's impossible), without doing, ignoring others, undaunted by, with no regard for, and taking advantage of.

points.title: 〜なくして(は): without (… impossible)
points.summary: Noun + なくして(は) + negative = without N, (it wouldn't work).
points.body: - 努力**なくして**成功はあり得ない.
examples: {努力|どりょく}なくして{成功|せいこう}はあり{得|え}ない。

points.title: 〜ことなしに: without doing
points.summary: Dictionary form + ことなしに (+ negative) = without doing A, B can't happen.
points.body: - 挑戦する**ことなしに**成長はない.
examples: {挑戦|ちょうせん}することなしに{成長|せいちょう}はない。
There's no growth without taking on challenges.

points.title: 〜をよそに: ignoring (others' worries)
points.summary: Noun + をよそに = paying no attention to others' concern / opposition / expectations.
points.body: - 親の心配**をよそに**、彼は一人で旅に出た.
examples: {周囲|しゅうい}の{反対|はんたい}をよそに、{二人|ふたり}は{結婚|けっこん}した。
Ignoring everyone's objections, the two got married.

points.title: 〜をものともせず: undaunted by
points.summary: Noun + をものともせず = not letting a hardship stop you (praise).
points.body: - 彼はけが**をものともせず**、最後まで走り抜いた.
examples: {嵐|あらし}をものともせず、{船|ふね}は{出航|しゅっこう}した。
Undaunted by the storm, the ship set sail.

points.title: 〜を顧みず: with no regard for
points.summary: Noun + を顧みず = disregarding (one's own safety, family …). 顧みる = look back on / care about; 省みる = reflect on oneself.
points.body: - 自分の危険**を顧みず**、子供を助けた.
examples: {彼|かれ}は{自分|じぶん}の{危険|きけん}を{顧|かえり}みず、{子供|こども}を{助|たす}けた。
With no thought for his own safety, he saved the child.

points.title: 〜をいいことに: taking (bad) advantage of
points.summary: Noun / plain form + の + をいいことに = using a situation as an excuse to do something wrong.
points.body: - 先生がいないの**をいいことに**、生徒たちは騒ぎ始めた.
examples: {親|おや}が{留守|るす}なのをいいことに、{彼|かれ}は{友達|ともだち}を{呼|よ}んで{騒|さわ}いだ。
Taking advantage of his parents being away, he had friends over and partied.

questions.prompt: {努力|どりょく}（　）、{成功|せいこう}はあり{得|え}ない。
notes: ともなく = 'without really meaning to'.
ならでは = 'unique to'.
ながらに = 'while / as (from birth)'.

questions.prompt: {皆様|みなさま}のご{協力|きょうりょく}（　）、このプロジェクトは{完成|かんせい}しなかったでしょう。
notes: なくても = 'even without' — clashes with 完成しなかった.
協力ないでは isn't grammatical.
なしにも isn't the pattern.
questions.translation: Without your help, this project would never have been completed.

questions.prompt: {人|ひと}は{誰|だれ}にも{頼|たよ}る（　）{生|い}きていくことはできない。
notes: ことだし = 'since (it's the case that)'.
ことにして = 'pretending that'.
なくして follows a noun ({努力|どりょく}なくして), not a verb.
questions.translation: No one can live without relying on someone.

questions.prompt: What does 「{挑戦|ちょうせん}することなしに{成長|せいちょう}はない。」 mean?
options: Don't challenge yourself before you've grown.
Challenges have nothing to do with growth.
There's no growth without taking on challenges.
notes: No order of events.
ことなしに isn't 'unrelated'.
なしに + ない = without A, no B.

questions.prompt: {親|おや}の{心配|しんぱい}（　）、{彼|かれ}は{一人|ひとり}で{旅|たび}に{出|で}た。
notes: をいいことに = taking (bad) advantage of — the parents' worry isn't an opportunity.
を通して = 'through'.
をもとに = 'based on'.
questions.translation: Ignoring his parents' worries, he set off travelling alone.

questions.prompt: {周囲|しゅうい}の{反対|はんたい}（　）、{二人|ふたり}は{結婚|けっこん}した。
notes: をもとに = 'based on'.
をめぐって = 'concerning (a dispute)'.
をいいことに = taking (bad) advantage of — objections aren't an opportunity.
questions.translation: Ignoring everyone's objections, the two got married.

questions.prompt: {彼|かれ}は{足|あし}のけが（　）、{最後|さいご}まで{走|はし}り{抜|ぬ}いた。
notes: をよそに is for others' feelings or situations, not your own hardship.
をもって = 'by means of / as of'.
をおいて = 'apart from'.
questions.translation: Despite his injured leg, he ran all the way to the finish.

questions.prompt: What does 「{嵐|あらし}をものともせず、{船|ふね}は{出航|しゅっこう}した。」 mean?
options: Because of the storm, the ship didn't sail.
The ship sailed into the storm by accident.
The ship sailed before the storm.
Undaunted by the storm, the ship set sail.
notes: It did sail.
It was deliberate.
No timing.

questions.prompt: {彼|かれ}は{自分|じぶん}の{危険|きけん}（　）、{川|かわ}に{飛|と}び{込|こ}んで{子供|こども}を{助|たす}けた。
questions.explanation: With no regard for: **を顧みず**.
notes: 省みる = reflect on (your own conduct) — same sound, different word.
振り返らず = 'without looking back'.
見ず = 'without looking'.
questions.translation: With no thought for his own safety, he jumped into the river and saved the child.

questions.prompt: {家族|かぞく}（　）{仕事|しごと}ばかりしていた{父|ちち}は、{今|いま}になって{後悔|こうかい}している。
notes: 省みる = reflect on yourself — not on your family.
をおいて = 'apart from'.
をいいことに = taking advantage of — 家族をいいことに makes no sense here.
questions.translation: My father, who neglected his family and only worked, now regrets it.

questions.prompt: {先生|せんせい}がいないの（　）、{生徒|せいと}たちは{騒|さわ}ぎ{始|はじ}めた。
questions.explanation: Taking advantage of: **をいいことに**.
notes: をよそに = ignoring someone's worry — the teacher isn't there to worry.
をもって = 'by means of / as of'.
を限りに = 'as of (the last time)'.
questions.translation: Taking advantage of the teacher's absence, the students started making a racket.

questions.prompt: What does 「{親|おや}が{留守|るす}なのをいいことに、{彼|かれ}は{友達|ともだち}を{呼|よ}んで{騒|さわ}いだ。」 mean?
options: Since his parents were away, it was good that he invited friends.
He invited friends so his parents wouldn't be lonely.
His parents were away, which was good for him.
Taking advantage of his parents being away, he had friends over and partied.
questions.explanation: をいいことに = **exploiting the situation**.
notes: いいことに isn't praise — it's taking advantage.
The parents were away.
It's about what he did, not a judgement.
